name: @openelement/element
//: ADR-0155 (docs/adr/ADR-0155-client-only-entry-subpath.md) governs the "./client-only" export below: it is the full public surface minus the compiled claim executor, pinned to the same publicShapeSha256 as ".", and is deletable as one unit when its written retirement condition is met. ADR-0166 (docs/adr/ADR-0166-regions-axis-entry-subpaths.md) governs "./no-regions" and "./base" the same way for the when/each Region builders axis (#1548). Recorded as a JSON annotation key rather than a `//` comment because the package-graph reader (tools/lib/package-graph.ts) fails loud on JSONC.
//sideEffects: The paths name three install edges (#1425 class): the default entry is flagged as the importer — a side-effect-free module loses its bare `import './internal/compiled/runtime/claim-install.ts'` and `regions-install.ts` — together with the installers claim-install.ts (`installClaimExecutor(...)`) and regions-install.ts (`installRegionBuilders(...)`), both module-scope calls; `./client-only` imports the regions install, `./no-regions` the claim install, so those importers are flagged too. A tree-shaking bundler therefore cannot drop server-DOM hydration or when/each Region execution. Everything else in src/ evaluates pure and stays tree-shakeable. The packed artifact mirrors these paths with compiled .js names in the release manifest (tools/release/npm-manifest.ts SIDE_EFFECTS) — change the two together; the guard is packages/element/__tests__/side-effects-declaration.test.ts.

scripts.browser:test: pnpm run browser:compile && vitest run --root ../.. --project element-browser
scripts.browser:gate: pnpm run browser:install && pnpm run browser:test && pnpm run browser:negative
scripts.browser:gate:full: pnpm run browser:install && OE_BROWSER_MATRIX=full pnpm run browser:test && OE_BROWSER_MATRIX=full pnpm run browser:negative
